title: LiteLMGuard: Seamless and Lightweight On-Device Guardrails for Small Language Models against Quantization Vulnerabilities
abstract: arXiv:2505.05619v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The growing adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) has influenced the development of Small Language Models (SLMs) for on-device deployment across smartphones and edge devices, offering enhanced privacy, reduced latency, server-free functionality, and improved user experience. However, due to on-device resource constraints, SLMs undergo size optimization through compression techniques like quantization, which inadvertently introduce fairness, ethical and privacy risks. Critically, quantized SLMs may respond to harmful queries directly, without requiring adversarial manipulation, raising significant safety and trust concerns. To address this, we propose LiteLMGuard, an on-device guardrail that provides real-time, prompt-level defense for quantized SLMs. Additionally, our guardrail is designed to be model-agnostic such that it can be seamlessly integrated with any SLM, operating independently of underlying architectures. translated_title: LiteLMGuard：面向小型语言模型量化漏洞的无缝轻量级设备端安全护栏
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）的日益普及推动了小型语言模型（SLM）在智能手机和边缘设备上的设备端部署，这类部署带来了更强的隐私保护、更低的延迟、无需服务器的功能以及更好的用户体验。然而，由于设备端资源受限，SLM 需要借助量化等压缩技术进行模型体积优化，这无意中引入了公平性、伦理和隐私方面的风险。尤为关键的是，量化后的 SLM 可能无需任何对抗性操纵便直接响应有害查询，引发了严重的安全与信任问题。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 LiteLMGuard，一种为量化 SLM 提供实时、提示级防御的设备端安全护栏。此外，我们的护栏采用模型无关的设计，可与任何 SLM 无缝集成，其运行独立于底层模型架构。我们的 Lit……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了 LiteLMGuard——一个轻量级、模型无关的设备端安全护栏，能够为量化后的小型语言模型提供实时、提示级的防御，防止其在无需对抗攻击的情况下直接响应有害查询。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LiteLMGuard, a lightweight and model-agnostic on-device guardrail that provides real-time, prompt-level defense for quantized small language models, preventing them from directly responding to harmful queries without any adversarial manipulation.
